currentState: Flat 1 shot consumption per physical attack or spell cast
designPrinciple: Cost proportional to projection, range, and area of effect.
notes: Bows consume 2-3 shots; AoE attacks scale x1 (1-3 mobs), x2 (4-8 mobs), x3 (9-16 mobs).

sourceConcept: Tiered Armor Set System (3-Piece Partial & 5-Piece Complete)
currentState: Binary set requirement where only full sets grant bonuses
designPrinciple: Reward incremental gear progression through intermediate synergy tiers.
notes: Enables partial activation (+5% Max HP, small P.Def) when 3 pieces of 5 are equipped.

currentState: Safe +3 on weapons, +4 on full armor; failure yields crystals/gemstones
designPrinciple: Predictable low-level risk with material recovery on high-level failures.
notes: Aden Arena already adheres strictly to the canonical classic enchantment model.

currentState: Special Abilities upgrade without deterministic 5-level safety checkpoints
designPrinciple: High-investment probabilistic upgrades require safety milestones to prevent catastrophic regression.
notes: Failures reset only to the nearest 5-level checkpoint rather than wiping all progress.

currentState: Implemented with random roll stat pools and skill triggers
designPrinciple: Secondary randomized stat customization over base gear.
notes: Fully functional for mid-to-high tier weapon customization.

sourceConcept: Guaranteed Compounding Pity Gauge for Dolls
currentState: Doll synthesis uses fixed success chances without visual pity accumulator
designPrinciple: Extreme RNG bad luck must have a guaranteed escape valve to sustain player engagement.
notes: Each failed synthesis grants +10 pity points; 100 points guarantees 100% success on next try.

sourceConcept: Common Craft Universal Kill Charge Gauge
currentState: Grinding produces gold, exp, and direct drops; no universal charge bar exists
designPrinciple: Grinding sessions should continuously charge a universal crafting meter for utility items.
notes: Allows players to craft Enchant Scrolls, Magic Tablets, and Blessing Scrolls passively from mob kills.

sourceConcept: Dwarf Recipe Book & Refined Material Assembly
currentState: Only 13 recipes exist in CRAFTING_RECIPES; 95% of D/C gear cannot be crafted
designPrinciple: Refined materials must flow into complete equipment sets to give meaning to gathering and mining.
notes: Add canonical recipes for Brigandine, Manticore, Mithril, Full Plate, Bastard Sword, and Elven Bow.

sourceConcept: Raw Resource -> Refined Resource -> Equipment Assembly
currentState: Refinery produces Steel, Cord, Leather, etc., but recipes_drops.js drops complete gear directly
designPrinciple: Closed economic loop where harvesting fuels refining, which fuels gear production.
notes: Shift monster drops toward patterns and raw materials, making the refinery the true gateway to elite gear.

sourceConcept: Permanent Item Sacrifice for Account-Wide Combat Stats
currentState: Obsolete gear is sold in bulk for negligible Adena via sellAllJunk
designPrinciple: Transforming obsolete gear into permanent account stats provides an eternal economic sink.
notes: Creates Season 1 collections (Talking Island, Gludio, Dion) where surplus gear is consumed permanently.

sourceConcept: High-End Stat Research & Boss Accessory Synergy
designPrinciple: Massive endgame currency sink with epic jewel synergies.
notes: [SEASON 1 OUT OF SCOPE] — Reserved as macro currency sink for Seasons 2 and 3.

sourceConcept: Combat Companions with Weapon Affinity Buffs/Debuffs
currentState: Pets provide generic stat boosts independent of hero weapon type
designPrinciple: Symbiotic synergy between hero weapon choice and companion specialization.
notes: Wolf buffs Daggers/Spears, Hawk buffs Bows, Buffalo buffs Heavy 2H, Kookaburra buffs Staves.

sourceConcept: Magic Lamp Variable EXP/SP Rolls from Mob Kills
currentState: Documented in balance data but lacks front-end celebratory roll mechanics in idle
designPrinciple: Stochastic micro-jackpots inject excitement into prolonged grinding sessions.
notes: Grants Green (65%), Blue (30%), Purple (4%), or Red (1%) lamps every 1,000 mob kills.

currentState: Has 5% tax and Cloud sync, but lacks formal 10-lot cap and 14-day expiry enforcement
designPrinciple: Artificial listing scarcity prevents market spam and stabilizes database overhead.
notes: Formalize 10 lot capacity and 14-day automatic return to inventory.

currentState: Fully aligned with mathematical monotonicity and smooth growth rates <= 1.45x
designPrinciple: Elimination of irrational leveling walls in favor of predictable effort.
notes: LevelEngine already conforms to the master contract.

sourceConcept: World Boss Raid Mechanics & Epic Drops
currentState: Queen Ant implemented at Lv 45 (World Boss) / Lv 30 (Raid) with Ring and Doll drops
designPrinciple: Signature pinnacle raid providing definitive milestone for Season 1 mastery.
notes: Queen Ant serves as the climax boss of Season 1.
